title: FaithfulFaces: Pose-Faithful Facial Identity Preservation for Text-to-Video Generation
abstract: arXiv:2605.04702v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Identity-preserving text-to-video generation (IPT2V) empowers users to produce diverse and imaginative videos with consistent human facial identity. Despite recent progress, existing methods often suffer from significant identity distortion under large facial pose variations or facial occlusions. In this paper, we propose FaithfulFaces, a pose-faithful facial identity preservation learning framework to improve IPT2V in complex dynamic scenes. The key of FaithfulFaces is a pose-shared identity aligner that refines and aligns facial poses across distinct views via a pose-shared dictionary and a pose variation-identity invariance constraint. By mapping single-view inputs into a global facial pose representation with explicit Euler angle embeddings, FaithfulFaces provides a pose-faithful facial prior that guides generative foundations toward robust identity-preserving generation. translated_title: FaithfulFaces：面向文生视频生成的姿态忠实面部身份保持
translated_abstract: 身份保持的文生视频生成（IPT2V）使用户能够生成具有一致人物面部身份的多样且富有想象力的视频。尽管近期取得了一定进展，现有方法在大幅面部姿态变化或面部遮挡的情况下常常出现明显的身份失真。本文提出FaithfulFaces，一个姿态忠实的面部身份保持学习框架，用于改进复杂动态场景下的IPT2V。FaithfulFaces的核心是一个姿态共享身份对齐器，它通过姿态共享字典和姿态变化-身份不变性约束，对不同视角间的面部姿态进行精细化与对齐。通过将单视角输入映射为带有显式欧拉角嵌入的全局面部姿态表示，FaithfulFaces提供了一个姿态忠实的面部先验，引导生成基础模型实现鲁棒的身份保持生成。特别地，我们开发了一个专门的流程来……
tldr: 提出FaithfulFaces框架，通过姿态共享身份对齐器将单视角输入映射为带显式欧拉角嵌入的全局面部姿态表示，为文生视频生成提供姿态忠实的面部先验，显著改善大姿态变化和面部遮挡下的身份保持效果。
en_tdlr: FaithfulFaces introduces a pose-shared identity aligner that maps single-view inputs into a global facial pose representation with explicit Euler angle embeddings, providing a pose-faithful facial prior for robust identity-preserving text-to-video generation under large pose variations and facial occlusions.
